Wire-time slowdown by budget and mutual divergence (messages per side): each cell is the session's serialized wire cost — measured in virtual time as a delay-sweep slope, so compute is excluded — relative to the same divergence under an unbounded budget. The link is latency-only, so these are worst-case factors, independent of the delay itself; a real link's bandwidth absorbs them: once transfer time exceeds window stall (dispute throughput `budget / (3 × RTT)` at or above the link rate), the factor is 1.
